[PREFERENCE] User wants to know about room service breakfast options at The Edgewater Hotel.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Room service breakfast is available from 6:00 AM to 11:00 AM on weekdays and 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM on weekends.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Breakfast menu includes continental items, eggs, pancakes, healthy options, and specialty items.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Edgewater Hotel accommodates dietary restrictions, including gluten-free, vegetarian, vegan, and dairy-free options.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Room service can be ordered by dialing the room service extension or using the hotel's mobile app.
